info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Cancellation API allows users to efficiently cancel multiple airline flights in a single request. This API is essential for travel agencies and airline operators managing large volumes of flight cancellations, enabling streamlined operations and improved customer service. By providing a centralized endpoint, it simplifies the process of updating flight statuses in the system. Typical consumers include airline customer service teams and automated systems that handle ticket management and travel itineraries.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing flight reservation by providing necessary identifiers. Ensure to check the cancellation policy prior to making a request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details necessary for canceling a flight. Ensure that the provided information conforms to the expected schema to successfully cancel the flight.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling a flight operation via a DELETE request. The value is expected to be a string that provides relevant information regarding the cancellation.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier associated with the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the cancellation process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Detailed message regarding the cancellation operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful flight cancellation operation.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
